imbues.name: Vampiric
imbues.description: Heal 30% of damage dealt on each strike
imbues.lore: The blade drinks first; the wielder walks away fed.

stone.name: Vampiric Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Warm to the touch, and never for a good reason.

imbues.name: Sundering
imbues.description: Deals 2x effective damage to Armored foes
imbues.lore: Plate is a promise. This is the argument that breaks it.

stone.name: Sundering Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Quarried from a fortress gate that lost.

imbues.name: Keen
imbues.lore: An edge honed past honest steel, into intent.

stone.name: Keen Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: It teaches a weapon exactly where to look.

imbues.name: Venomous
imbues.description: Foe loses 5 HP after combat (cannot kill)
imbues.lore: The wound closes. The debt does not.

stone.name: Venomous Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Kept in wax, handled with tongs, sold with a smile.

imbues.name: Binding
imbues.description: 30% chance to Root the foe for 1 phase after combat
imbues.lore: Some oaths are sworn to the ground itself.

stone.name: Binding Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Etched with knots no sailor will name.

imbues.name: Warded
imbues.lore: A weapon that remembers it is also a shield.

stone.name: Warded Imbuing Stone
stone.lore: Chapel-cut stone, still humming its last hymn.

prismaticStone.name: Prismatic Stone
prismaticStone.lore: Six colors sleep inside it. The weapon chooses which one wakes.
